name: Lab Management Agent
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends chromium fonts-liberation fonts-noto-color-emoji && npm install && pip install --user -r requirements.txt && mkdir -p data

ADMIN_KEY.description: A long random password you make up. Protects the /admin page (QR code, Excel upload/download).

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.description: 16-character Gmail app password used to email POs to vendors.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Only needed to understand free-form sentences.
